sections.name: Global News
sections.description: Events and affairs outside the United States — wars, disasters, courts, institutions, and world news as it happens; the center is what occurred beyond the US, not the politics around it.

sections.name: Global Politics
sections.description: Governments, elections, and power outside the United States — foreign leaders, parties, elections, diplomacy, and geopolitics; the center is who holds or contests power abroad.
